description: This file is a documentation source file for the torch.distributed.tensor module in the PyTorch library. It contains structured markup, code snippets, class and method references, and links for documenting the Distributed Tensor (DTensor) features, classes, and APIs. It is not executable source code but a documentation page.

classes.name: DTensor
classes.description: A subclass of torch.Tensor that supports distributed tensor sharding, collective communication, and other distributed tensor operations in PyTorch.

classes.name: DeviceMesh
classes.description: Represents the topology of devices in a multi-dimensional array, used to define communication patterns for DTensor.

classes.name: Placement
classes.description: Defines the sharding layout of a tensor on a DeviceMesh, supporting types like Shard, Replicate, and Partial.

classes.name: CommDebugMode
classes.description: Provides debugging tools for understanding collective communication and sharding in DTensor.

methods.name: distribute_tensor
methods.description: Creates a DTensor from a logical tensor across processes, sharding or replication based on given layout.

methods.name: distribute_module
methods.description: Distributes an nn.Module for parallel training using DTensor sharding.

methods.name: zeros
methods.description: Creates a DTensor filled with zeros, specifying device mesh and placement.

methods.name: ones
methods.description: Creates a DTensor filled with ones, specifying device mesh and placement.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized DTensor on specified device mesh and placement.

methods.name: full
methods.description: Creates a DTensor filled with a specified value, on the specified device mesh and placement.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Creates a DTensor with random values, on specified device mesh and placement.

methods.name: randn
methods.description: Creates a DTensor with random normal distribution values.

methods.name: visualize_sharding
methods.description: Visualizes the sharding layout of a DTensor with less than 3 dimensions.
